items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 17 October 2026 4:19am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 17 October 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

A settled weekend ahead:
Dry and sunny today and Sunday, with light winds. Daytime temperatures will be near average at around 12°C, but with cold nights for the time of year leading to widespread grass frosts.


##Outlook##

High pressure will gradually progress eastwards to Northern Europe on Monday. Conditions should remain dry, though becoming cloudy for a time in the afternoon.

As the week goes on increasingly unsettled weather will develop.
